description:
[modeled, RISK AHEAD, CEX, over time] The same estimated CEX map as get_liquidation_map but
    as a time series: grid[t][b] is the estimated USD of leveraged positions with their
    liquidation price in price bin b at time cols[t] (ms), bins[b] the bin's centre price (240
    bins fitted to the traded range), price[t] the close. A level disappears once price trades
    through it. Call this only to see WHEN a cluster formed and whether it survived; for the
    current picture call get_liquidation_map (far smaller answer, split by leverage and exchange).
    The answer is large (about 35,000 numbers). symbol: BASEUSDT. exchange: all | binance | bybit
    | okx. range: 12h | 1d | 3d | 7d.
    PRICE: the full map is a metered call ($0.005, or a key). Without a key this tool returns the
    free summary: USD on each side of the price and the largest level on each side.

exchange.description: Venue id (binance, bybit, okx, bitget, hyperliquid, gate, htx, kucoin, mexc, bingx, aster, kraken, gmx) or 'all' where the tool allows it.
exchange.title: Exchange

range.description: Price range around the current price: 12h | 1d | 3d | 7d (and 'max' where stated), the traded range of that window.
range.title: Range

symbol.description: Contract as BASEUSDT, e.g. BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT (1000PEPE and kPEPE fold to PEPEUSDT).
symbol.title: Symbol
